items.title: 1. Destruction of Eco Systems and Biodiversity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 1. Destruction of Eco Systems and Biodiversity: a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Tel, heavy metals aur pesticides jaisi pollution, aur daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein jane wale nuqsan-deh chemicals, plastic aur kachra, ecosystems aur aquatic life (pani ki zindagi) ko sakht nuqsan dete hain. Polluted pani mein oxygen kam ho jati hai (hypoxia), aur pani ke jaandaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Coral reefs kharab hote hain aur food chains bigar jati hain. Zehreele chemicals, sewage aur industrial waste aquatic organisms (pani ke jaandaron) ko maar ya nuqsan pohancha sakte hain, is liye pani mein zindagi ki qismein kam ho jati hain. Polluted pani breeding cycles (bachay paida karne ke chakkar), food sources (khuraak ke zariye) aur migration patterns (hijrat ke raaste) bigar deta hai; is se population (tadaad) ghatti hai aur sensitive (nazuk) species bilkul extinct (khatam) bhi ho sakti hain. Pani par depend karne wale parinde aur janwar bhi affect hote hain.
